node.title: Supply Chain Rationalization & Process Mining
node.reading:
A global luxury group needed to understand and rationalize technology across highly complex supply chain environments.

In luxury, supply chain complexity is not only about moving products from factory to boutique. It includes small production series, thousands of components, long repair lifecycles, high‑value spare parts, multi‑country movements, fiscal and compliance‑driven flows, many legal entities and very high customer expectations.

Loosely speaking, logistics is not “mission critical” in the petrochemical sense, but it is reputation‑critical: service failures, unclear repair timelines or repeated delays directly affect brand trust and perceived value.

In this context, supply chain intelligence is not just an efficiency lever. It becomes part of the promise made to the client when they buy or service a high‑value piece.

relations: Evidence-gated widening offers a design question for process discovery: when does another data source materially change the decision?
La búsqueda de rutas y la selección de fuentes son problemas distintos. Un criterio de ampliación debe evitar excluir procesos invisibles o grupos mal instrumentados.
Operational traces can anchor a conservative estimate of compensatory work while leaving their coverage gaps explicit.
La telemetría puede omitir trabajo fuera de pantalla y confundir revisión necesaria con deuda. El paper es un protocolo, no un estimador ya validado.
In the supply-chain case, process traces were interpreted as evidence for architecture decisions rather than treated as a complete portfolio answer.
El texto público no acredita que todas las cadenas dispusieran de logs completos ni que process mining midiera por sí solo todo el ahorro del programa.
Field workarounds become more informative when linked to process traces that show their trigger, authorization and effect on the receiving operation.
Una ruta frecuente o no conforme no demuestra necesidad causal ni debe convertirse automáticamente en procedimiento autorizado.
